```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U35_13_Test_Suite

**Target System:** Hospital Data Management System

**Test Objective:** Verify the non-functional and functional requirements of the system.

**Test Scope:**
- Hospital staff access to patient consultation requests.
- Chemists and labs access to data based on National Institute of Technology, Surathkal, Karnataka need to know.
- High availability and reliability of the system.
- Usability of the screens.
- Improvement of the Disease Prediction Database.

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Verify high availability of the system | VIRTUA-13-21 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | N/A | N/A | System is accessible and responsive. |
| TC-002 | Verify high reliability of the system | VIRTUA-13-22 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | N/A | N/A | System operates without errors or crashes. |
| TC-003 | Verify usability of the screens | VIRTUA-13-23 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | N/A | N/A | Screens are displayed with large font size and clear navigation. |
| TC-004 | Verify patient data confidentiality | VIRTUA-13-18 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | N/A | N/A | Patient data is encrypted and accessible only to authorized personnel. |
| TC-005 | Verify doctor access to consultation requests | VIRTUA-13-19 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | Doctor credentials | N/A | Doctor can access patient consultation requests. |
| TC-006 | Verify chemist and lab access to data | VIRTUA-13-20 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | Chemist/lab credentials | National Institute of Technology, Surathkal, Karnataka need to know data | Chemist/lab can access data based on their need. |
| TC-007 | Verify improvement of Disease Prediction Database | Req-14 | Positive | System is deployed and running. | N/A | N/A | Disease Prediction Database is updated with learning from the previous month. |

```
